lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: رُجَّتِ is in the derivative form: رُجَّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ر/ج/ج   r–j–j the dregs of society, the dregs in a drinking trough; to shake, to agitate, to rouse, (of the sea) to become tumultuous, turmoil, commotion, excitement, the sound of thunder.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
رُجَّ rujja and رَجّ rajj.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
رُجَّ rujja [pass. of v. رَجَّ rajja, trans.] to be shaken, to be caused to quake

(56:4) إِذَا رُجَّتِ الأَرْضُ رَجًّا when the earth is shaken violently.
